scenarios.label: Avoidance
scenarios.narrative: At this pace, the small moments of friction keep getting postponed. Reaching your long-term vision will take longer, since the daily micro-choices aren't yet pointed in that direction.

scenarios.label: Drifting
scenarios.narrative: You're inconsistent but not stuck — some days line up with your vision, others don't. A small, repeatable anchor habit would tip this balance toward steady progress.

scenarios.label: The Steady Path
scenarios.narrative: You build resilience through gradual, intentional friction. By facing discomfort early in the day, you set the foundation for mastering a skill and moving toward your long-term goals. Your baseline focus increases noticeably.
